Trader Joe’s uses Service Channel and the Service Channel mobile app.
Customer Rules Must be followed! Note: Service Channel recognizes the phone GPS so tech needs to be within 2 miles of the store to log in/out.
 ***IMPORTANT*** If you are unable to log in or out of Service Channel – you can use our phone based automated response system (IVR) by dialing 516-500-7776. Take pictures of login error and save to dispatch
Techs need to check into Service Channel work order when arriving on location.
1.	After checking into Service Channel, techs should head in store and ask to speak with Captain/Manager on Duty. Introduce yourself and explain why you are onsite.
2.	Once you are shown equipment needing diagnosing, take pictures of data tags and asset tags. Specifically, pictures of Model and Serial number are mandatory.
3.	Once diagnosis is complete, confirm NTE on work order and determine if fixes can be completed same day.  
4.	If yes, assuming under NTE, tech can source parts locally to complete same day repairs but MUST call Climate Pros purchasing team for Tech PO (630-283-7316).
5.	If yes, but NTE will be exceeded, techs need to call their SM or CSS Keri Adams at 224-315-7139.
6.	If no verbal approval is given, techs need to move dispatch to PUR: NEED PARTS and check out of store with MOD.
7.	All return work MUST be quoted and submitted to the FM for approval unless verbal approval has been obtained.
8.	Once back in vehicle, techs should update FJX dispatch notes AND Service Channel work order notes. 
9.	Move Service Channel work order to correct status:
10.	In Progress/Incomplete or In Progress/Awaiting Quote if we cannot repair same day. 
11.	COMPLETED/PENDING CONFIRMATION if work is complete.

***Refrigerant adds - All refrigerant adds MUST be logged in SC and in dispatch notes. NO EXCEPTIONS. Dispatch notes, parts tab, and refrigerant tracking form should match the amount of the gas add.  Once refrigerant added, Service Channel work order should be moved to COMPLETED/PENDING REFRIGERANT USE so Customer Success Teams can track usage. Techs need to be mindful of question about refrigerant use in Service Channel. If refrigerant is used, they must answer YES.**
